scope: Architecture-test classification and its existing finisher/append production path
policy: A new operation reports Operation and Prediction. A retained exploratory test links an earlier review containing its Decisive test. The same reviewer judges whether an operation is substantive; the guard validates declarations and evidence fields, not mathematical novelty.
controls: control.txt passes four native methods and 18 subtests; after generic gap closure, control-strengthened.txt passes the same four methods and 28 subtests

targeted.classification: target-classification.txt: missing/unknown disposition and production-path tests fail
targeted.operation_prediction_floor: target-operation.txt, target-prediction.txt and target-floor.txt: native report-floor test fails
targeted.retained_evidence: target-boundary.txt, target-review_kind.txt, target-earlier_test.txt and target-target_link.txt: native earlier-review test fails
targeted.integration: target-integration.txt: only the production progress-path test fails when its new guard call is removed
targeted.independence: Each of the four native methods guards at least one targeted defect no other method guards; no redundant native method is retained. Target variants change only the copied production module.

generic.first_run: generic.txt: 112 killed and 17 survivors; every surviving diff is saved as mutant-N.txt and read
generic.gap_closure: Existing tests strengthened for multiline disposition, multiline fields and earlier articles, entirely missing fields, and visible-text length under HTML tags and entities. Generic-recheck.txt kills all six behavioral survivors: 7,49,58,66,67,82.
generic.equivalence: 23 replaces the missing-note fallback by XXXX, which still matches neither valid kind. 70 replaces the missing-field fallback by XXXX, which still remains below the report floor and raises the same validation error.
generic.cosmetic_scope: The nine listed variants only add padding or change case in error-message text; acceptance and rejection behavior is unchanged. No exact-message assertions were added merely to kill them.
generic.generation_scope: The copied full production module generated 4861 mutants, but only the 129 selected function mutants were run. First generation took 26204 ms for one file; recheck reused unchanged source in 26 ms. Mutmut's single-file generation is serial; selected tests ran with four workers. No claim is made about the unselected functions.
generic.evidence: mutation-stats.json preserves the runner statistics; generic.txt and generic-recheck.txt preserve the complete selected verdicts. Earlier kills are reused only with the unchanged source function.

real_inputs.evidence: real-notebooks.txt: the existing tested API ran against main and the largest registered notebook, with source byte and article-tag counts printed
real_inputs.negative_control: The actual unsupported review draft was rejected on both inputs, while a retained reference to an actual earlier test was accepted. No notebook was edited by this measurement.
real_inputs.limitation: The measurement covers classification validation, not all finalizer checks or mathematical novelty. A quoting error was corrected before accepting the measurement; no failed run is counted as a result.

initial_failures: The full suite initially exposed three stale architecture fixtures, which were updated to the new declaration. A subsequent suite had one unrelated per-test reviewer-cleanup latency failure; its threshold was unchanged. After genuine test strengthening, the final complete suite passed. No resource or timing limit was relaxed.
administration: The prevention change does not consume a research cycle or route review; the active review clock retains its work, failures and retries.
